meta.name: dispatching-parallel-agents
meta.description: Use when facing 2+ independent tasks that can be worked on without shared state or sequential dependencies

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 并行执行多个独立任务，无需等待顺序完成
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要同时处理多个互不依赖的任务
copy.tagline_en: Execute multiple independent tasks in parallel without waiting
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to handle multiple independent tasks simultaneously

howto.what: 当你有多个互相独立的失败或任务时，Claude 会将每个问题分派给不同的子代理并行处理，每个子代理有独立的上下文，专注于自己的任务，最后返回各自的发现和修复总结。
howto.when: 当你面对3个以上独立根因的测试失败、多个子系统独立故障，且每个问题无需其他上下文、无共享状态时触发。

say.text: 前端白屏和后端超时是独立问题，各派一个代理分别排查。
say.note: 两个任务无共享状态，并行提高效率。

howto.what_en: When you have multiple independent failures or tasks, Claude dispatches each problem to a specialized sub-agent with isolated context. All sub-agents work in parallel, focusing on their own task, and return summaries of their findings and fixes.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you face 3+ test failures with different root causes, multiple independently broken subsystems, and each problem can be understood without context from others, with no shared state.

say_en.text: Fix these three test files in parallel: abort.test.ts, batch.test.ts, approval.test.ts.
say_en.note: Three independent tasks can run concurrently.

say_en.text: White screen and backend timeout are separate issues, assign one agent each.
say_en.note: No shared state, parallel execution boosts efficiency.
